title: Multi-view
subtitle: {{n}} of {{max}} on the wall
shortcutFocusEnds: Focus the first or last slot
shortcutGiveSound: Give the focused tile the sound
shortcutSwapTile: Move the focused tile to another slot
wallKeysHint: Arrow keys move between tiles. Enter gives the focused tile the sound. Delete closes it, R replaces its channel, S moves it to another slot.
layout1x2Disabled: Holds two channels. Close a tile first.
fullscreenUnavailable: Full screen is not available here
emptyTitle: Watch up to four channels at once
emptyBody: Pick two to four live channels. Every tile plays; the one you click has the sound.
noSources: Multi-view plays live channels from your sources. Add a source first.
swapping: Pick a tile to swap with
lockedBody: Enter the PIN to watch it here.
hiddenBody: Unlock with the PIN to show it.
unlockBody: Enter the PIN to show {{name}} and other hidden channels until the lock returns.
lockCheckFailed: The tile stays dark until the check works.
sourceMissing: This channel's source is gone. Replace the channel or close the tile.
errorOffline: The tile tries again when the connection is back.
errorAuth: The provider refused this stream. Check the account in Sources.
errorNotFound: The provider has no stream at this address right now.
errorTimeout: No video arrived in time. Try again or pick another channel.
errorServer: The provider's server failed. Try again in a moment.
errorUnsupported: The built-in player can't play this stream. Open it in the main player instead.
errorNetwork: The stream stopped arriving. Try again.
errorMedia: The stream's video could not be decoded.
errorLimit: This account allows fewer streams than the wall uses. Close one of its tiles.
errorGeneric: Try again or pick another channel.
limitTitle: Too many tiles from one account.
limitBody_one: {{source}} allows {{count}} stream at a time and the wall uses {{tiles}}. Tiles past the limit may not play.
limitBody_other: {{source}} allows {{count}} streams at a time and the wall uses {{tiles}}. Tiles past the limit may not play.
limitOwn: Recordings or the main player also use streams from this account.
mainPlaying: The wall stays silent until it stops.
pickerAllPromptHint: Type a channel name, or choose one source to browse it.
pickerEmptySource: This source has no live channels
pickerNoSources: Add a source to pick channels from.
pickerFull: The wall is full. Close a tile to add another channel.
pickerAtLimit: Every stream {{source}} allows is already on the wall. Another tile from it may not play.
toastFullHint: Close a tile to add another channel.
toastUnsupported: Only live TV channels go on the wall
toastGateFailedHint: The channel was not added. Try again.
toastUndoFull: Can't put it back: the wall is full or the channel is on it again
announceSwapStart: Moving {{name}}. Pick the tile to swap with, or press Escape.
